newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells extra 3.3 bln Ffr BTANs.
newsitem.headline: France sells extra 3.3 bln Ffr BTANs.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold
a further 3.302 billion francs of BTANs after Thursday's
auction, increasing the total value of bonds sold to 26.102
billion francs.
Following are the final results of the BTAN auction:

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell 21 to 23 billion francs of BTANs in total. The total bid cover ratio of the auction was 1.8.

Under the French system, primary dealers and central banks not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
